domains.title: Addresses and domains
domains.adminHelp: Configure hosting DNS zones, quotas and public node endpoints. Domains do not replace port allocations.
domains.help: Addresses belong to a service. Changing a name or display alias does not change its allocated port. Bots using outbound connections only do not require a domain.
domains.failed: The operation failed. Please try again.
domains.empty: This service has no assigned addresses yet.
domains.disabled: The administrator has not enabled domains yet. Public DNS addresses are not being assigned.
domains.noEndpoint: Public DNS is not configured. Local/LAN service addresses and ports are independent of public domains.
domains.copyFailed: Unable to copy. Select the address and copy it manually.
domains.removeHelp: This address will be detached from the service. Automatically managed records will be removed; the name remains temporarily reserved. Remove your custom DNS records at your provider.
domains.name: Record name
domains.customHelp: Add these records at your DNS provider. Keep the ownership TXT record for future checks. SRV supplies the Minecraft Java port. Set address records to DNS only, without an HTTP proxy.
domains.managedHelp: The panel creates Cloudflare records. With manual DNS, the administrator creates them. Minecraft SRV points to the allocated service port.
domains.allowCustom: Allow users to connect custom domains
domains.automaticHelp: Only one domain can assign addresses automatically. This includes existing configured Minecraft services with an allocated port. Requires the system and domain enabled, user selection allowed and Cloudflare.
domains.providerReady: A Cloudflare token is configured. Zone access will be verified during DNS operations.
domains.providerMissing: No Cloudflare token configured. Manual DNS remains available. Set DOMAIN_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN on the backend to enable automation; never share the token in chat.
domains.endpointHelp: This is a public connection endpoint, not the agent listen address. Configure its hostname at your DNS provider. The port comes from the service allocation. Address changes trigger domain rechecks.

errors.DOMAIN_INVALID_HOSTNAME: Enter a valid public hostname without a protocol, port or path.
errors.DOMAIN_INVALID_PREFIX: The name is reserved or invalid. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (up to 32 characters).
errors.DOMAIN_INVALID_ALIAS: Descriptions can contain up to 80 characters.
errors.DOMAIN_PUBLIC_IP_REQUIRED: Enter at least one valid public IP address.
errors.DOMAIN_INVALID_PROVIDER: Check the DNS provider, Zone ID and automatic assignment option.
errors.DOMAIN_ZONE_IN_USE: The zone is in use. Its hostname and provider cannot be changed.
errors.DOMAIN_ZONE_OVERLAP: This domain overlaps an existing zone.
errors.DOMAIN_HOSTNAME_TAKEN: This address is taken or temporarily reserved.
errors.DOMAIN_ZONE_UNAVAILABLE: This hosting domain is unavailable for the service.
errors.DOMAIN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The service address limit has been reached.
errors.DOMAIN_USE_MANAGED_ZONE: This is a hosting domain. Select the hosting subdomain option.
errors.DOMAIN_BUSY: The address is being checked or was checked recently. Wait at least 30 seconds and refresh.
errors.DOMAIN_ENDPOINT_REQUIRED: An administrator must configure a public node endpoint, and the service needs an allocated port.
errors.DOMAIN_OWNERSHIP_PENDING: The ownership verification TXT record was not found.
errors.DOMAIN_DNS_PENDING: DNS does not yet match the expected address and port. Check the instructions or wait for propagation.
errors.DOMAIN_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: An administrator must configure the Cloudflare token and Zone ID.
errors.DOMAIN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The DNS provider is temporarily unavailable.
errors.DOMAIN_PROVIDER_FAILED: The DNS provider rejected the operation. Check the token and zone permissions.
errors.DOMAIN_ZONE_MISMATCH: The Zone ID does not match the configured domain.
errors.DOMAIN_RECORD_CONFLICT: Foreign DNS records exist. The panel will not overwrite them; an administrator must resolve the conflict.
errors.DOMAIN_MANUAL_CLEANUP_REQUIRED: An administrator must remove manually managed DNS records before releasing this name.
errors.DOMAIN_CHECK_FAILED: DNS verification failed. The address reservation was retained.
errors.DOMAIN_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: The service does not exist or you do not have access.

domains.entitlementsHelp: Panel defaults apply unless overridden by an administrator or the future billing integration. Lowering limits does not delete existing addresses. No selected zones means all available zones.
domains.replaceHelp: The new address will be reserved and the previous one scheduled for removal. DNS propagation takes time; a custom hostname needs a new TXT verification. The previous name remains temporarily reserved.
